_comment: Global site configuration: navigation, theme registry, and serverless integrations. Edit this file to change structure/behaviour without touching personal data.

meta.title: Sivashankar Palraj | Engineering Lead — Embedded Systems, Autonomy & IoT
meta.description: Portfolio of Sivashankar Palraj, an engineering lead specialising in embedded systems, ultra-low-power IoT and autonomous robotics.

integrations._comment: All integrations are free-tier, serverless, client-side services. Set enabled=true after creating your own account/endpoint so no secrets ever need to live in this repo.

contactForm.instructions: Create a free form at https://formspree.io (no card required), copy the form endpoint URL, paste it above and set enabled=true.

testimonialForm.instructions: Use a second free Formspree form (or reuse the contact one) so testimonial submissions land in your inbox for review before you add them to data/testimonials.json.

hitCounter.instructions: Uses the 9trees/daily hit counter API. The page code must be registered and active in the Django admin, and https://sivashankaruav.github.io must be in HIT_COUNTER_ALLOWED_ORIGINS. One POST is sent per page load and returns today/total counts.
